doc: His art taste. Three parts blended: guideline (the house look: n1m21n-room/brand, direction A night room + B riso sketchbook), emotion (what he feels shifts the target via param_semantics), learned (drifts toward pieces that left him serene). Axes are 0..1 knob positions. Edit freely; run tools/art/gen_art.py after.

guideline.note: dark ink/deep grounds, volt+lavender dominant (70/20/10 ink-volt-cream), accents rare; hypnotic loops; riso grain, crisp lines, lines boil on twos
